question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **GARRULOUS**
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. Talkative .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **Garrulous** refers to a person who is excessively talkative, especially on trivial matters.
 
• Among the given options, **Talkative** is the most appropriate synonym, as it directly matches the meaning of the word.
 
• Other options like **Reserved**, **Silent**, and **Listen** are either antonyms or irrelevant in this context.

Correct sentence: *The synonym of **Garrulous** is **Talkative**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Other synonyms of Garrulous:** Loquacious, Chatty.
 
• **Antonyms of Garrulous:** Reserved, Quiet, Reticent.
